prompts.title: Ocean Drive Leisure
prompts.prompt:
Photorealistic luxury lifestyle fashion portrait of a handsome man with neatly styled hair, standing confidently and casually leaning against a classic vintage luxury sedan parked on a scenic coastal mountain road. He wears a light blue finely textured button-down shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearms over a clean white crew-neck T-shirt, high-waisted cream tailored trousers with a relaxed straight fit, brown suede loafers, and a classic wristwatch. His hands are gently clasped in front of his waist, legs casually crossed at the ankles, body relaxed, looking toward the right side with a calm, sophisticated expression.
A dark brown/black vintage luxury sedan with chrome detailing, polished bodywork, classic wheels, and warm tan leather interior fills the middle ground. Dramatic Mediterranean-style coastline and rugged golden-brown mountains in the background, deep blue ocean stretching into the distance, clear pale-blue sky, subtle coastal haze. Warm golden-hour sunlight coming from the top right side, creating natural highlights on the face, clothing, car, and landscape with long cinematic shadows across the road. Elegant old-money aesthetic, timeless European summer fashion, refined masculine styling, cinematic editorial photography.
Composition: full-body vertical portrait, subject centered slightly right, car extending horizontally across the frame, ample sky and coastal scenery visible, natural perspective, balanced negative space.
Camera: eye-level angle, 85mm lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, sharp subject with gently softened background, realistic proportions.
Quality: ultra-photorealistic, 8K resolution, HDR, ultra-detailed skin texture, realistic fabric details, cinematic color grading, high dynamic range, premium fashion editorial photography, realistic reflections and shadows, no distortion, no blurry details, no text, no watermark. aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Mini Avatar Collection
prompts.prompt:
Create a square 1:1 collage featuring six premium 3D chibi-style renders of the same subject, arranged in a clean 3-column × 2-row grid. The subject should be reusable for any person, so use the uploaded/reference person as the base subject and transform them into a cute stylized 3D chibi character while keeping the same subject identity consistent across all six panels.

The character should have a charming animated look with an oversized head, large glossy eyes, soft rounded facial features, rosy cheeks, a small nose, a warm smile, and thick fluffy hair adapted from the subject. Keep the same subject consistent in all six panels, while changing only the outfit, pose, and expression according to each scene below.

Use soft studio lighting, rich vivid smooth gradient backgrounds with clean saturated color depth, where the outer area stays more solid and colorful while the area near the subject becomes lighter and softer, subtle floor shadows, crisp fabric textures, detailed hair strands, and a clean high-resolution polished finish. Add a soft subtle rim light along the outer edges of the subject, especially around the hair, shoulders, arms, and clothing silhouette, so the character stays clearly separated from the background without looking overlit.

Panel 1 — Top Left:
A full-body subject standing calmly with both hands inside the hoodie pocket, gentle friendly smile, looking at the camera.
Outfit: olive green hoodie, dark charcoal jogger pants, white low-top sneakers, small pendant necklace and wrist bracelet.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with sky-blue as the more solid outer color, becoming a lighter warm peach glow near the subject.

Panel 2 — Top Middle:
A confident stylish subject standing with hands in pockets, one eye winking, cheerful smile.
Outfit: backward dark baseball cap, blue denim jacket, black-and-white striped t-shirt, black slim jeans with rolled cuffs, black-and-white sneakers, headphones resting around the neck, wristwatch.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with bright aqua-to-teal as the more solid outer color, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 3 — Top Right:
A joyful energetic subject laughing with eyes closed, both arms raised in celebration.
Outfit: bright yellow sweatshirt with bold “PLAY” text, loose black joggers, colorful sporty sneakers.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with warm golden yellow and coral pink as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 4 — Bottom Left:
A thoughtful subject standing in a cute thinking pose, one hand touching the chin, soft serious expression.
Outfit: dark bomber jacket, white graphic t-shirt, tan cargo pants, high-top black-and-white sneakers, small backpack straps visible.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with lavender and soft pink as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 5 — Bottom Middle:
A relaxed subject sitting on a small wooden stool, holding a smartphone in one hand, calm pleasant smile.
Outfit: cream oversized sweatshirt, soft blue joggers, clean white sneakers, subtle bracelets.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with pastel green and pale yellow as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 6 — Bottom Right:
A cool fashionable subject standing with one hand in pocket and the other making a peace sign, confident playful smile.
Outfit: dark knit beanie, beige-and-black plaid overshirt over a black t-shirt, layered silver chain necklace, ripped black jeans, chunky sneakers, wristwatch and bracelet.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with blush pink and mint as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Overall style: ultra-clean premium 3D cartoon render, cute chibi proportions, detailed realistic clothing materials, expressive faces, smooth soft shading, polished cinematic character design, vibrant pastel color harmony, adorable social-media avatar aesthetic.

prompts.title: Torn Paper Personas
prompts.prompt:
Create a set of 9 expressive 3D cartoon-style avatar stickers of the same person, arranged in a clean 3×3 grid layout.
The character must maintain consistent facial structure, proportions, skin tone, and identity across all frames.

STYLE (CRITICAL):
Highly stylized Pixar / emoji-style 3D character, with slightly oversized head and smaller compact body (chibi-like proportions).
Eyes must be slightly larger, round, and highly expressive.
Facial expressions should feel cute, playful, and exaggerated, not realistic.
Soft, smooth, rounded features with a friendly, Pixar-style premium finish.

EXPRESSIONS & VARIATION:
Each frame must have different expression, different body language, and different outfit with different colors, including:
winking and pointing, cool & stylish, thinking with hand on chin, arms crossed calm pose, thumbs-up, drinking, waving, joyful laughing, and confused/serious look.

COMPOSITION (STRICT):
Each avatar appears to emerge through a torn paper hole, with realistic, ripped edges wrapping naturally around the half-body. Use the light grey gradient colour inside the paper hole.
Character should feel slightly popping out (3D depth), not flat.
Only half body (chest-up).
Perfect grid alignment, equal spacing, no distortion.

LIGHTING:
Soft studio lighting, even and clean.
No harsh shadows. Smooth highlights.

BACKGROUND (LOCKED):
Single cool, crisp pure white background across entire grid.
No gradient, no variation, no color shift between tiles.

CONSISTENCY RULE:
All 9 avatars must clearly look like the same person with identical identity.

RENDER QUALITY:
Ultra-clean, high-resolution, sharp, polished 3D render.
No artifacts, no deformation, no realism bias, no plastic look.

Aspect Ratio:
4:5 vertical (full grid fits perfectly)

prompts.title: Hoodie Hottie
prompts.prompt:
Edit this photo into an ultra-photorealistic, hyper-realistic 8K UHD masterpiece with razor-sharp focus and cinematic quality. The image is a close-up portrait of a woman taking a selfie indoors against a gray background. She wears a red oversized sweater featuring cool graffiti on the chest, with the hood pulled over her head. Her porcelain-white skin appears smooth and radiant. Her long, waist-length hair is straight with slight volume at the ends.
 
She looks down toward the camera with a warm smile, one eye closed playfully, and one hand resting on her head holding the hood. Her makeup is natural, with curled eyelashes and soft pink lips. The lighting is bright daylight, captured from the side and slightly above, featuring diffused sunlight and gentle reflections on the background.
 
Maintain 100% fidelity to the original facial features.
